messages:
emily_se: quick sync — Catalyst enterprise pilot: we need a consolidated integration timeline and clear owners. customer requires SSO (OIDC), S3 export of transcripts, and per-route latency SLAs. can eng confirm realistic dates? cc @max_infra @ben_eng @raja_ml

max_infra: for SSO we'll need their OIDC metadata + IP allowlist. infra effort is small but depends on their idp config. estimate: can have infra-side ready by 2025-07-18 if we get metadata today. i can own the network/infra side.

ben_eng: i'll own the S3 export pipeline. need the event/transcript schema and retention requirements. can we lock schema by Fri? i'll open a PR for the adapter today — @sara_eng and @mike_front can you review?

raja_ml: model routing and perf: recommend pinning to rdx-small for pilot to meet latency targets. i'll run perf tests against the expected load shape once we have export QPS numbers. owner for model side: raja_ml.

tasha_pm: i'll formalize success criteria with the customer. proposed acceptance: SSO auth working end-to-end, exports validating against schema, and p50 latency <150ms for 512-token gen. customer also asked for a canary rollout plan. i'll get written acceptance by Thu.

emily_se: thanks. can engineers add a short checklist here with owners + dates? proposed milestones: schema lock 2025-07-11, SSO live 2025-07-18, exports tested 2025-07-22, canary roll 2025-07-25.

ben_eng: ack. opening schema PR now. will include sample payload. assigning reviewers: @sara_eng, @mike_front.

sara_eng: :thumbsup: i'll review the schema PR tomorrow morning.

mike_front: i'll implement the SSO settings UI and the connect flow. ETA 2025-07-16 for front-end so we can test with staging.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/staging -> 2025-07-20 02:00 UTC (auto).

emily_se: if you need customer creds for S3 testing, ping me and i'll request temporary keys. flag blockers by EOD so we can escalate.

ben_eng: one potential blocker — we need either join access to their S3 account or a pre-provisioned bucket with write permissions and a known prefix. emily, can you ask them to create a bucket named something like `catalyst-redwood-exports` and a path `/redwood/catalyst/`?

emily_se: on it — emailing Catalyst now. example policy i asked them to attach: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::catalyst-redwood-exports/*"]}]
}
```

ben_eng: perfect, thanks. once they confirm bucket + creds i'll start end-to-end test.

emily_se: thanks all — will update here after i hear back from the customer. if anything changes on your side, drop a quick note so i can reprioritize the pilot schedule.
